ImageDescription.value: This photo was taken from Kauri Pass area of Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve, Uttarakhand India. The photo was clicked at 5:00 am before the sunrise in the area. The sun was present behind the mighty Nanda Devi Peak and about to rise. In the photo their are three layers of clouds are present. Lowest layer of clouds moving upward from the lowland valleys. The middle layer of clouds encircling mighty Nanda Devi Peak. The upper and third layer of clouds present above the peak. In the third layer their is reflection of mighty peak forming dark black area in the white cloud just above the peak. Sun rays are radiating throughout the mountain range.
